title: Sun White and Gaudet's son lost to Joe Robichaux
summary: He explains how members of his band were lured to Robichaux after he won the contest again.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Oh I see. He never worked with the Chinatown, Sun White.

Let me see. Sun worked there a while, but his son's mother died and he got a wife, didn't want him to play no music, he started working at the child at the hospital. So I got Russ, I had Gaudet's son, Gaudet's son, Russ Lund got his son, Russ Lund got his son, his drums, Russ, you understand? And had Gaudet's son. Well, Joe got hot because, that bunch got hot because we went back to St. Monica's and won the contest and he still got ready and he still, uh, uh, uh. stuff
Gordette's son away from me too.
You know he went to- Joe Robichaud or what's Joe?

Joe Robichaud. He was playing at Durbin and Jackson at that time. And then after the city death, we wind up taking Gordette with him, you know, the daddy, and then this boy Gordette had a son, his brother had a boy by the name of Doc, well I had him alternate until I got Raymond. Raymond started playing with this band there, went there with the Natchez fire. Walter Bach. Yeah, well Raymond's wife, first wife, or one of his wives, the seven that got burnt up in that fire. But he didn't get burned. No, Raymond didn't. And Raymond was driving one of these, for Atlantic and Pacific, you know these big old wholesale grocery, wholesale trucks. He lived on a mile of street. He's planning on coming back and we're planning on getting another group together.
